name: Liikluskindlustuse seadus
note: Different from LKindlS (already in corpus). This is motor insurance OSAGO equivalent.

sections.title: Kindlustuskohustus
sections.body: Insurance obligation: vehicles registered in Estonia's traffic register must carry motor liability insurance before operation.

sections.title: Kindlustusjuhtumi mõiste
sections.body: Insured event: traffic accident causing damage to third parties.

sections.title: Kindlustussumma
sections.body: Minimum coverage: €1,300,000 for property damage, €6,450,000 for personal injury per incident. Subject to periodic EU indexation.

sections.title: Kindlustusjuhtumi käsitlemise tähtaeg
sections.body: Claims must be resolved within 30 calendar days of notification. Extensions only for pending court proceedings.

sections.title: Automaatne kindlustuskaitse
sections.body: Automatic insurance: uninsured registered vehicles receive statutory coverage via Liikluskindlustuse Fond with standardised premiums.

sections.title: Regressinõue
sections.body: Recourse rights: insurer may recover from at-fault driver for intentional conduct, severe traffic violations, substance impairment, unlicensed driving.
